name: Institutional Swiss
tagline: White ground, bold Inter headlines over hairline rules, three ruled columns and a single signal red. (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: white paper, near-black ink, one signal red accent, grey secondary text

typography.style: single grotesque family; bold headlines, small tracked caps labels

best_for: Reports and briefings that must read as neutral and trustworthy, with several parallel points per slide. Fits institutions, public bodies and research groups.
avoid_for: Playful or emotional storytelling where a restrained grid would feel cold.
